nodes.label: Filtration Engine
nodes.rationale: Screens multi-asset universes for high-probability entries and suppresses low-quality setups; replaces rigid all-or-nothing parameter matching with a weighted scorecard.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Architecture
nodes.rationale: Every candidate setup passes through Gatekeepers first (binary reject), then Weighted Scorecard only if gates pass — so low-quality setups never consume scoring capacity.

nodes.label: Stage 1: Gatekeepers
nodes.rationale: Binary pass/fail conditions; fail any one and the setup is rejected before scoring.

nodes.label: Stage 2: Weighted Scorecard
nodes.rationale: 100-point scale across seven confluence categories; each weight reflects historical reliability as a probability driver.

nodes.label: Minimum Risk:Reward Gate
nodes.rationale: Projected R:R (structural invalidation vs. target liquidity) must be ≥ 1:2; below that reject regardless of confluence score.

nodes.label: HTF Directional Bias Gate
nodes.rationale: HTF trend must resolve to exclusively Bullish or Bearish; Ranging HTF disqualifies the setup outright with no scoring applied.

nodes.label: Session / Kill-Zone Timing Gate
nodes.rationale: Entry must fall inside the asset's active liquidity window; setups outside kill zones are down-weighted or rejected (wording conflicts with pseudocode penalty-only behavior).

nodes.label: Multi-Timeframe Alignment (HTF bias → LTF trigger)
nodes.rationale: Weight 20, Critical/Gate. HTF trend regime (50/200 EMA) with LTF BOS/CHoCH firing in same direction as HTF bias.

nodes.label: Market Structure Shift + Displacement
nodes.rationale: Weight 20, Critical. Sharp displacement leg leaving an unmitigated FVG or inverse FVG; confirms institutional intent, not a slow drift.

nodes.label: Order Flow / Microstructure
nodes.rationale: Weight 15, High. CVD divergence vs. price, Order Book Imbalance ≥60% one side, footprint delta clusters (trapped orders).

nodes.label: Volatility Expansion Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Weight 15, High. IV percentile ≤20th expanding, price outside 2nd-dev VWAP band on heavy relative volume, ADX>25 with +DI/-DI cross.

nodes.label: Premium/Discount Positioning
nodes.rationale: Weight 10, Medium. Entry in discount (longs) or premium (shorts) zone of HTF dealing range; not chasing an extended move.

nodes.label: Macro / Intermarket Correlation
nodes.rationale: Weight 10, Medium. DXY inverse check, SMT divergence between correlated pairs (EURUSD/GBPUSD, BTC/ETH), equity-index anchor (ES/NQ) for crypto risk-on/off.

nodes.label: Asset-Class Specific Layer
nodes.rationale: Weight 10, Medium. Volume Profile/session behavior specific to the instrument; Category 7 filters are not interchangeable — apply only the matching asset layer.

nodes.label: Futures Layer (ES, NQ, YM, RTY)
nodes.rationale: Volume Profile & session deviations around HVN/Value Area; footprint delta clusters for absorption; VIX>16 for equity index futures; NY AM 07:00–10:00 ET primary kill zone, 10:00–11:00 Silver Bullet secondary.

nodes.label: Forex Layer (FX)
nodes.rationale: London/NY overlap session gating; interest-rate/swap differentials favoring positive carry; news blackout ±15m around CPI/NFP/FOMC; London 02:00–05:00 ET for EUR/GBP, NY AM for USD continuation.

nodes.label: Crypto Layer
nodes.rationale: OI expansion validates breakouts; deeply negative funding + short liquidations flags squeeze longs; BTC/ETH SMT for hidden accumulation; NY AM kill zone; widen FVG threshold >0.15% of price.

nodes.label: Indices Layer (Broad Market)
nodes.rationale: ES/NQ as macro risk gauge; VIX>16 gatekeeper, VIX>30 favors mean-reversion over breakout; ES vs NQ SMT as exhaustion fade; 09:30–10:30 ET NYSE cash open highest-conviction window.

nodes.label: Gold Layer (XAUUSD)
nodes.rationale: DXY inverse ~−0.85; co-moving DXY/gold is rare regime shift — reduce size; check real yields (US 10Y minus inflation expectations); EURUSD cross-check for gold longs; London daily high/low, NY AM continuation.

nodes.label: Trade Rating System
nodes.rationale: Final tier from total scorecard points plus minimum R:R floor; a higher score with insufficient R:R is capped at the tier below.

nodes.label: A+ Tier
nodes.rationale: Score 60–74, min R:R 1:2. All 3 gatekeepers pass; HTF/LTF alignment + Market Structure Shift both scored. Baseline tradable — smallest position size.

nodes.label: A++ Tier
nodes.rationale: Score 75–89, min R:R 1:3. Everything in A+, plus Order Flow and Volatility Expansion both scored; at least 5 of 7 categories contributing. Standard position size.

nodes.label: A+++ Tier
nodes.rationale: Score 90–100, min R:R 1:4. All 7 categories scored, Macro/Intermarket confirmed (not neutral), entry in primary kill zone. Maximum position size for cleanest rarest setups.

nodes.label: Technical Implementation Checklist
nodes.rationale: Operational build list: Asset Screener, Directional Gating, Scoring Engine, R:R Pre-Calculation, Correlation Cross-Reference, Session Gating.

nodes.label: Asset Screener
nodes.rationale: Continuously sweep selected universe for high RVOL and expanding ATR/IV percentile.

nodes.label: Directional Gating
nodes.rationale: Classify HTF trend as Bullish, Bearish, or Ranging; Ranging = automatic rejection (Gate 2).

nodes.label: Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: Run the 100-point scorecard only after both gatekeepers (R:R, directional bias) pass — checklist cites two gates while architecture names three.

nodes.label: R:R Pre-Calculation
nodes.rationale: Auto-calculate invalidation (structural swing high/low) against target liquidity zones; reject under 1:2 before scoring runs.

nodes.label: Correlation Cross-Reference
nodes.rationale: Cross-check DXY, ES/NQ, and BTC/ETH SMT divergence for every candidate regardless of asset class — correlated markets are cross-referenced, not siloed.

nodes.label: Session Gating
nodes.rationale: Gate alerts to each asset's primary kill zone; setups outside windows are down-weighted, not treated equally.

nodes.label: evaluate_trade Scoring Logic
nodes.rationale: Reference pseudocode: hard REJECT if R:R < 2.0 or HTF RANGING; killzone miss sets score_penalty; add category weights (20/20/15/15/10/10/10); assign A+++/A++/A+/NO TRADE by score and R:R floors 4.0/3.0/2.0.

nodes.label: Position Sizing by Tier
nodes.rationale: Assigned tier A+/A++/A+++ determines position sizing from smallest baseline to maximum for rarest full-confluence setups.

nodes.label: Kill Zone
nodes.rationale: Asset-specific active liquidity window used by Session/Kill-Zone gate and asset layers; A+++ requires primary kill zone entry.

nodes.label: VIX Filter
nodes.rationale: Only trade ES/NQ/YM setups when VIX > 16; low-VIX sessions reduce win rate on breakout entries; extreme VIX >30 favors mean-reversion.

nodes.label: SMT Divergence
nodes.rationale: Smart Money Technique divergence across correlated instruments (BTC/ETH, ES/NQ, EURUSD/GBPUSD) as confluence for accumulation, exhaustion, or relative strength.
